description: This file contains a shell script designed to verify wireless interface bring-up/down, status, and configuration on a device running OpenWrt. It utilizes commands like `wifi`, `uci`, and `ubus` to check wireless states and configurations, using various text processing tools (grep, sed, sort, etc.) to normalize output for testing purposes.

methods.name: verify_wifi_bringup_down
methods.description: Script snippets for toggling wireless interface states with `wifi down` and `wifi up`, then checking interface status.

methods.name: validate_uci_config
methods.description: Command to verify wireless UCI configuration exists for radios and SSIDs.

methods.name: check_wireless_status
methods.description: Command using `ubus` to fetch and normalize wireless status information.
